interface_note: Detail-scoped question input returns checked-fact selections and optional requirement proposals. No autonomous purchases or deletions. Native successful inference was unavailable; browser unavailable-state behavior and source/test contracts were inspected. Score is a limited heuristic tally, not model-quality measurement.

findings.message: The UI reports AI unavailable but still enables Hỏi AI; browser submission fails with LOCAL_AI_UNAVAILABLE. The disable condition only considers busy and boot state.
findings.remediation: Gate generation on actual availability, provide download/recheck actions where appropriate, and leave source facts usable without AI.

findings.message: The UI describes facts as checked, but imported title and structured fields conflict for sampled listings (Acer 512GB versus storage 2048; MacBook 8GB title versus ram 256). Contract-valid fact selection does not resolve source accuracy.
findings.remediation: Identify contradictory attributes, withhold an unsupported value from AI assertions/filter conclusions, and label unresolved evidence specifically. Do not invent numeric confidence or choose a title value without source review.

findings.message: The fallback exposes raw Error: LOCAL_AI_UNAVAILABLE and directs users to facts below, while the facts are above the AI panel.
findings.remediation: Use a plain-language reason, a status-appropriate next action, and an accurate link or scroll action to the facts. Retain the user's question and existing requirements.

strengths.message: AI is explicitly named and on-device processing is disclosed; the interface explains its limited fact-selection/proposal role.
Source offers cancel and sends proposals into a draft for review; only confirm commits requirements.
Historical-price and suitability caveats remain visible. Unsupported generated prose is rejected in source and unit checks.

api_note: UXUI_API_KEY was absent. Internal-knowledge review only; no paid API or complete live taxonomy audit was performed. See https://uxuiprinciples.com/en/checkout for optional enrichment.
